task.title: Skill training speed in SP per minute from primary and secondary attributes
task.goal: Add a pure domain function that returns a skill's training speed in SP per minute as primary + secondary / 2, with no rounding inside the function (the caller rounds), and an explicit domain error rejecting zero and negative attributes. Out of scope: implant bonuses (s0-t4) and training time (s0-t3).
task.acceptance_summary: primary 17 / secondary 17 -> 25.5, 27/21 -> 37.5, 32/26 -> 45.0, always a float with no intermediate rounding; primary 0, secondary 0 or any negative attribute raises an explicit domain error; the backend test suite stays green and offline.

subtasks.title: Add sp_rate.skill_sp_per_minute with an attribute domain error
subtasks.goal: Create backend/src/app/domain/skills/sp_rate.py with skill_sp_per_minute(*, primary: int, secondary: int) -> float computing primary + secondary / 2 via true division so the result is always a float and no rounding happens inside; raise a new InvalidSkillAttributeError (ValueError subclass, in errors.py, following InvalidSkillRankError) when primary or secondary is zero or negative, naming the offending attribute in the message. Re-export the function and the error from the package __init__ like the existing domain symbols. Assumptions: attributes are integers as they come from the character sheet; arguments are keyword-only to match sp_table.py; table-driven tests for the acceptance pairs and error cases live in backend/tests/unit/test_sp_rate.py (written by the specifier, not listed in files_allowed).
